sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary: it preserves the required ship-to-case relationship, case applicability classification, all declared operand and result structures, lookup factors, canonical owners, datatypes, and units. betaIPrime and upperIceWaterlineLengthLUI are correctly ship-owned and required conditionally for the represented I2.3.1(v) applicability, without duplicating betaIPrime on the case or inventing an applicability boolean.
